resources.string: Firebase-ka maxalliga ahi iimayl dib-u-dejin ma diro. Kombiyuutarka ka fur xiriirka terminal-ka Start-LocalBackend. Qiimaha newPassword ku beddel erayga sirta ah ee aad dooratay.
Erayada sirta ahi isma waafaqaan. Fadlan mar kale geli.
Iimaylkan akoon ayaa isticmaala. Ku noqo gelitaanka ama dib u deji erayga sirta ah.

Firebase-ka maxalliga ah lama heli karo. Kombiyuutarka ka orod scripts/Start-LocalBackend.ps1 oo terminal-ka furnow. Telefoon USB ku xiran, shid USB debugging oo orod scripts/Connect-TestDevice.ps1. Akoonnada maxalliga ahi way ka duwan yihiin kuwa Firebase-ka tooska ah.
Horumarinta maxalliga ahi iimayl ma dirto. Badhankani wuxuu isticmaalaa koodhka emulator-ka. Akoonnada dhabta ahi waxay u baahan yihiin xaqiijinta iimaylka.
